**A self-hosted AI agent team that runs 24/7 on your own VPS, hands off with your local agent, and s
chedules heavy work to off-peak API pricing.**

## Why this, not something else
### 1. Local ↔ cloud handoff
When your laptop is online it does the work; when it goes offline, the cloud takes over. **Heartbeat
detection + takeover protocol** — no lost tasks, no re-running what already finished.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### 2. Pricing-aware scheduling
Heavy jobs move into off-peak API windows automatically. **Same work, half the cost.**
### 3. Agent boundaries live in YAML
What each agent can write, whether it needs approval, whether it is read-only or can execute — decla
red in `agents.yaml` and **enforced at runtime**, not requested from a model in a prompt.
### 4. Rule engine + LLM, two tiers
Deterministic work goes to the rule engine; only reasoning goes to the LLM. **Cheaper, reproducible,
work goes to the rule engine; only reasoning goes to the LLM. **Cheaper, reproducible, auditable.**
### 5. Bring your own thinking kernel
Not tied to any model. DSH, or any CLI that can output text. You can run it with no LLM at all and o
nly use the rule engine.
**⭐ How to plug in any model: docs/models.md** — Ollama (local), Claude, GPT-4o, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM
, Qwen, llama.cpp. One wrapper script each.

## The name
The name is not arbitrary. **Vigiliae** is the Roman night divided into four watches; **更柝** (*gēng
tuò*) is the Chinese night divided into five. Two civilisations, separated by continents and with no
contact, arrived at the same institution: **cut the night into shifts and hand each shift to the ne
xt, so someone is always awake.**
